core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghiyath corresponds to the Arabic form غياث (Arabic root غ و ث (gh-w-th); غياث (Ghiyāth)). Its core sense is succour, aid, relief. Ghiyath is a transliteration of Arabic غياث (Ghiyāth) 'succour, aid'. The source gloss 'help, aid' is correct. The source's Arabic column mistakenly gave غيث (Ghayth, 'rain'); both derive from adjacent senses of relief and are closely related names.
